title: Signal Garden solo loop completed with three restorations in live Studio
scope: Manual player-input completion of the Signal Garden solo loop in one local desktop Studio Play session, corroborated by two HUD captures showing Restorations 1 and 3 and by the post-restoration Echo reset. This does not cover two clients, touch/controller input, physical-device performance, visual approval, saving, or publishing.

sourceIdentity.scope: Git-tracked and nonignored workspace files in their current working-tree contents, excluding the listed artifact roots.
sourceIdentity.note: The running place was built from 0a2e97d; projects/signal-garden is unchanged between 0a2e97d and 682a24a.

run.input: Manual player input in the Studio Play session

hud: The archive is ready for another expedition.
Gather an Echo before returning to the archive.

observations: The first capture, at 13:10:43Z, shows Restorations 1 with five Echoes carried and the message that the archive is ready for another expedition.
The second capture, at 13:15:12Z, shows Restorations 3 with archive charge 2/3 and no Echo carried.
All eight EchoFragment parts reported Collected=false at 13:15, consistent with the documented post-restoration reset.
The console contained only the Signal Garden bootstrap message and no error output.
The same Play session retained both Client and Server DataModels and the 18-node SignalGarden runtime scene.
limitations: Player actions were not instrumented per step; completion is corroborated by two HUD captures and the post-restoration reset, not by a timestamped server event log.
One local desktop client only; no second player or replication check.
Touch, controller, physical-device, and performance behavior were not measured.
No place change was saved, no asset was uploaded, and nothing was published.
Visual approval and independent review are not attached; this record supports only the narrow solo-loop completion it describes.
